name: How long does it typically take to install an exterior entry ramp?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to install an exterior entry ramp?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeline for an exterior entry ramp varies significantly based on its size, complexity, material, and site preparation needs. A simple, pre-fabricated aluminum ramp might be installed in a few hours. Custom wood or concrete ramps, especially those requiring extensive grading or foundation work, could take several days to a week. Permitting and inspection schedules can also influence the overall project duration. We provide a detailed project timeline after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation times vary from a few hours for simple ramps to several days or a week for complex custom designs.
